Wait for a CSS selector that exists on the page

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.crawlberg.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper().setPropertyNamingStrategy(com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.PropertyNamingStrategies.SNAKE_CASE)
    val engineConfig = mapper.readValue("{\"browser\":{\"mode\":\"always\"},\"ssrf\":{}}", CrawlConfig::class.java)
    val engine = Crawlberg.createEngine(engineConfig)
    val url = "https://example.com"
    val result = Crawlberg.interact(engine, url, listOf(mapper.readValue("{\"selector\":\"#content\",\"type\":\"wait\"}", PageAction::class.java)))
    println(result.actionResults.first().success)
    println(result.actionResults.first().actionType)
    println(result.actionResults.first().actionIndex)
}
```
